headline: Europe ERP disruption drags profit despite pricing gains
summary_short: LKQ's Q2 2026 revenue fell 3.0% y/y to $3,408M as a 12.6% organic decline in Europe (tied to an ERP implementation in Germany) outweighed growth in North America and Specialty; diluted EPS dropped 29.3% to $0.53 on lower segment profit.
summary_long: Revenue fell 3.0% y/y to $3,408M: Europe parts & services revenue dropped 9.6% ($154M), organic revenue down 12.6% on an ERP rollout disrupting Germany plus competition, partly offset by FX (+$34M) and acquisitions. North America grew 0.5% on pricing actions; Specialty grew 5.0% on marine/RV/auto volume. Segment EBITDA fell in Europe (-$42M), North America (-$17M) and Specialty (-$6M), pulling operating income down 24.7% to $225M and net income down 29.5% to $136M. Diluted EPS fell 29.3% to $0.53. Cash rose 4.2% y/y to $301M on $278M of net debt borrowings even as H1 free cash flow was $(36)M (vs. $186M a year ago). No forward guidance in this 10-Q.

This is a 10-Q, not an earnings release, so no CEO/CFO quotes are included; management attributes the quarter's softness mainly to a temporary ERP-driven volume disruption in Germany, partly offset by North America pricing actions and Specialty volume growth.
